Retrieve package objects and lazy-loaded datasets from data/.

Source: R/00-agrinutri_data.R
agrinutri_data_get.Rd

Lazy datasets are not always bound in asNamespace("agrinutri") when only the namespace is loaded (e.g. agrinutri::fun() without library(agrinutri)). Fall back to utils::data() so vignettes and :: calls work.

Usage

agrinutri_data_get(name)

Details

Kept in 00-agrinutri_data.R so collation loads this before other sources.
